changes: Use the shared admitted column-name collector for ordinary, stateful and deferred aggregate read plans.
Deferred early and late lists are planned within a scope held through execution and released on return/failure.
Share aggregate expression/column traversal and remove intermediate Object.values/filter arrays from these column planners.
Projection and partition lookups use own properties, preserving physical columns with names inherited from Object.prototype.

scenarios: Prototype-like constructor group column is included in the exact requested physical column list and aggregates correctly.
Tiny aggregate pools now reject during planning before the scanner opens; larger pools still return correct grouped count, median and count-distinct.
Existing grouped/scalar deferred selection, density fallback, cancellation and stateful checkpoint tests pass.

remaining: Other query-builder, physical-plan and parser/runtime allocations still require review.
Column planning uses the established explicit charge model, not total heap measurement.
Full allocation-matrix and Worker headroom acceptance remain open.
